create_segmentdataset: create a SegmentDataset from features dict and segments sequence with optional pad_duration
build_dataloader_from_segmentdataset: build a PyTorch DataLoader from a SegmentDataset instance using build_dataloader method
collate_segmentdata_batches: collate a list of SegmentData batches into a single SegmentData using collate_fn
load_all_segments_as_one_batch: load all segments in a SegmentDataset as one batch using as_one_batch method
pad_tensor_to_duration: pad or crop a tensor to a target length using the _pad_to helper function
